note: Both sets capture the same core facts (50° solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm, 0° window azimuth, truncated isosceles triangle louver shape, 25° structural bend, the depth-to-height algorithm, and the 1:1 ratio) with supporting quotes. B duplicates the louver shape claim (once with and once without the 'extruded' condition), giving it two duplicate pairs versus A's one (both sets repeat the solar altitude claim). A's binding of the 1:1 ratio to 'Harvest Shade Screen louver' is also slightly more precise than B's bare 'louver'.
remarks: Both sets repeat the solar altitude 50 degrees claim under two entity names ('Harvest Shade Screen' and bare 'solar altitude'). Both truncate quotes mid-word ('windo', 'longit'), which weakens quote support. Both omit the simplified relation Height = D*1.2, the proportional reduction of louver spacing based on average profile widths, and the screen transparency/powder-coated finish findings — arguably the most quotable engineering facts on the page.
